intent: Compare the shares of helium and hydrogen in the Sun's atmosphere.

requirements.question: Are all required composition entities, rings, and states represented?
Compare the shares of helium and hydrogen in the Sun's atmosphere.

units.claim: All required composition entities appear in single composition.
accept: all required labels or sectors are visible
each entity is correctly bound to its arc, center label, or annotation
reject: fabricated label for an unnamed remainder
entity assigned to the wrong panel or ring

units.claim: Helium (89.6%) occupies a larger share of the Sun's atmospheric composition than hydrogen (10.4%).
units.computation: compare r1.relative_value (0.896) vs r2.relative_value (0.104); helium > hydrogen
accept: Helium share is shown as larger than hydrogen share
Helium ≈ 89.6% and hydrogen ≈ 10.4% are both represented
The comparison correctly identifies helium as the majority share
reject: Hydrogen is shown as larger than helium
Only one of the two shares is shown
Shares are summed or combined into a single value without comparison

optional_valid: Displaying exact percentage labels for helium and hydrogen
Showing the pie as a full composition summing to 100%
unsupported_to_avoid: Deriving an unspecified remainder (both shares are specified)
Cross-panel or multi-ring comparison (single full pie)
Reporting an absolute count at the center
State change or animation tracing (snapshot clip)
review_notes: Intent asks for a comparison of two named shares, so a single composition_order unit captures the required analytical fact.
Both rows are slices of the same whole; no panel or series scope needed.
approval_basis: Human sampling review completed; remaining items approved as a batch.
